tob-10102: Johann Arndt’s seventeenth-century devotional work taught generations of Lutherans what faith should look like in daily life. tob-10802: Charles Squire’s survey gathers the gods, heroes, and fairy lore of Britain and Ireland into one readable volume. tob-4002: Niccolò Machiavelli’s ruthless little handbook advises rulers how to gain and keep power — by force when needed, by cunning always. tob-0202: The Kybalion packs the Hermetic teaching into seven tight laws — mind over matter, as above so below, rhythm, polarity, and the rest. tob-3002: Saint Augustine’s Confessions is the first true life-story in Western letters — the tale of a brilliant sinner’s long road to God.
